item.title: Kashmir Freezes Again; Gulmarg Coldest at –5.5°C, Zojila Plunges to –18°C
item.description: Srinagar, Dec 10 : The Kashmir Valley reeled under intense cold on Tuesday night as minimum temperatures dipped below the freezing point across most stations, with Gulmarg emerging as the coldest inhabited spot at –5.5°C. The harshest temperature, however, was recorded at Zojila Pass, where the mercury crashed to –18.0°C.
